import humanize

# R1 - Verify all required functions are accessible
functions = ['Unit', 'activate', 'apnumber', 'clamp', 'deactivate', 'fractional', 
             'get_translation', 'intcomma', 'intword', 'naturaldate', 'naturalday',
             'naturaldelta', 'naturalsize', 'naturaltime', 'ordinal', 'precisedelta',
             'scientific']
print('R1: All 17 required functions accessible:', all(hasattr(humanize, f) for f in functions))

# R2 - metric function works
assert hasattr(humanize, 'metric')
assert humanize.metric(1234) == '1.2 k'
assert humanize.scientific(1234) == '1.23 x 10³'
print('R2: metric and scientific work correctly')

# R3 - intcomma with ndigits=0
assert humanize.intcomma(1234.5678, 0) == '1,235'
assert humanize.intcomma(1234, 0) == '1,234'
print('R3: intcomma handles ndigits=0 correctly')

# R4 - Type hints exist (we verify they're present via inspect)
import inspect
sig = inspect.signature(humanize.naturaldelta)
assert sig.return_annotation == str, f'naturaldelta return type: {sig.return_annotation}'
sig = inspect.signature(humanize.naturalsize)
assert sig.return_annotation == str, f'naturalsize return type: {sig.return_annotation}'
sig = inspect.signature(humanize.naturaltime)
assert sig.return_annotation == str, f'naturaltime return type: {sig.return_annotation}'
print('R4: All three functions have -> str return type hints')

print()
print('All requirements verified successfully!')
"
